title: Generator Wars
summary: Tunde and Ngozi borrow a generator with permission, follow three marked junctions and agree an outdoor site and shared hours. The community gains a reliable meeting place while the bag investigation remains separate.

protect.text: Ngozi: We agreed to check privately first. A quiet, reliable place helps people speak in their own time.
protect.summary: The private-first pact shapes the request for a reliable meeting place.

public_case.text: Ngozi: A public case still needs a place to check sources privately. Permission comes before a microphone.
public_case.summary: The public-case pact still preserves private verification and consent.

stages.title: Two blocks. One very popular relative.
stages.text:
Neighbour One: That generator belongs to our block.
Neighbour Two: It attended my naming ceremony.
Tunde: Did it bring a gift or an extension cable?

Ask its custodian, Iya Risi, about a recorded loan. The disputed wedding bag and its contents stay out of this arrangement.
stages.summary: Ask Iya Risi for a recorded loan. The generator agreement does not use the disputed bag.

choices.label: Ask the custodian for permission and clear loan terms
Take it while the blocks argue
choices.hint: Ask Iya Risi first. Neighbourhood arguments do not replace the custodian's permission.

stages.title: A loan with a return line
stages.text:
Iya Risi: You may borrow it for the agreed community sessions. List it, list who is responsible, and bring it back after the last session.
Ngozi: A sentence with both permission and a return date. We are making progress.

Choose who will hold the written loan sheet. Both arrangements keep Iya Risi's ownership and the return obligation clear.
stages.summary: Record the custodian's permission, responsible borrower and return after the agreed sessions.

records.title: Community loan sheet
lines: Return: after the last agreed session
Wedding bag: excluded from the agreement

choices.label: Ngozi keeps the loan sheet; Iya Risi keeps a copy
All three keep matching loan-sheet copies

stages.title: The passenger list has a handle
stages.text:
Tunde: One generator. No fare dispute. A promising passenger.
Ngozi: The equipment travels secured. Nobody is riding beside loose cargo.

Compare the loan sheet with the collection list before leaving. Keep a copy of the handover record with the loan sheet.
stages.summary: Match the single listed generator and loan sheet, preserve the handover record and use the marked transport route.

choices.label: Confirm the listed item and recorded handover
Add another block's equipment without asking
choices.hint: Collect only the item on the agreed loan sheet.

stages.title: Junction 1 · the blue board
stages.text:
Passenger: Left at the blue board.
Another Passenger: My cousin says right.
Tunde: Is your cousin a road sign?

Approach the lower-lane safe bay and stop before choosing the junction. Manual pace/lane controls and guided approach both preserve the same story rewards.
stages.summary: Stop at the first lower-lane safe bay. The route cue is left at the blue board.

choices.label: Read the blue-board junction from the stopped bay

stages.title: One clear landmark beats two cousins
stages.text:
The route card marks a left turn at the blue board. A shop doorway on the right is not a through road.
Tunde: We are transporting an argument. We can at least give it the correct address.
stages.summary: Choose the marked left turn. A wrong suggestion gives a free correction at the stopped checkpoint.

choices.label: Take the marked left at the blue board
Try the shop doorway on the right
choices.hint: The blue-board route card says left. Leave the shop doorway clear; this correction costs nothing.

stages.title: Junction 2 · market crossing
stages.text:
The passengers turn the generator's imagined rattle into a chorus. The route remains readable without sound.
Ngozi: The chorus can wait for the crossing.

Stop in the lower-lane bay before the market junction. Continue only after the route choice is confirmed.
stages.summary: Reach the second safe bay and stop before the market crossing; no audio cue is required.

choices.label: Stay stopped and read the market route card

stages.title: A serving aisle is not a shortcut
stages.text:
The marked right-hand road goes around the market. The left-hand serving aisle belongs to people carrying lunch.
Tunde: Even my shortcut needs lunch sometimes.
stages.summary: Use the marked right-hand road after the crossing clears. Keep the serving aisle for pedestrians.

records.title: Junction 2 route card
lines: Marked route: RIGHT around the market

choices.label: Wait for the crossing, then take the marked right-hand road
Use the serving aisle to save a turn
choices.hint: The marked right-hand road goes around the market. Leave the serving aisle open.

stages.title: Junction 3 · community yard
stages.text:
Ngozi: Straight to the community-yard sign. Then a proper stop.
Tunde: Finally, a passenger who appreciates punctuation.

Follow the final leg and stop in the lower-lane bay at the yard. A missed bay offers the same free loop as the earlier route.
stages.summary: Follow the final leg to the community-yard bay and stop before handing over the equipment.

choices.label: Follow the straight-ahead yard sign from the safe stop

stages.title: Everyone arrives before the equipment moves
stages.text:
Ngozi: Parked. Passengers clear. Loan sheet here.
Tunde: Please record that the argument arrived intact.

Keep the bus stopped while the agreed handover is recorded. The site board comes next.
stages.summary: Record arrival and handover at the stopped yard. Keep the original loan and return terms.

choices.label: Record the handover with the bus parked and people clear
Start the handover while the bus is still moving
choices.hint: Finish the safe stop and keep people clear before the story handover.

stages.title: Give the meeting room its own air
stages.text:
The site board has three labelled proposals. A is an enclosed store. B blocks the canteen doorway beside a window. C is the designated open outdoor yard, with entrances, windows and the pedestrian route kept clear.

Ngozi: A meeting place should not require holding your breath.

Choose the suitable proposal on the site board.
stages.summary: Choose C, the designated open outdoor yard, away from openings and the pedestrian route. A and B get a free correction.

records.title: Proposed site board
lines: B: doorway beside a window; blocks the aisle
C: designated open outdoor yard; openings and pedestrian route clear

choices.label: C · designated open outdoor yard, openings and route clear
A · enclosed store
choices.hint: The enclosed store is unsuitable. Compare the open outdoor proposal C.

choices.label: B · doorway beside the window
choices.hint: Keep the doorway, window and pedestrian route clear. Proposal C is the designated outdoor site.

stages.title: Shared hours need two names
stages.text:
Block One: We need the first session.
Block Two: We also invented the first session.
Ngozi: Then we will write down two sessions before either of you invents the whole day.

Agree either shared schedule. Both preserve access and the return obligation.
stages.summary: Choose which block goes first; both schedules give each block a session and retain the recorded return.

choices.label: Block One first; Block Two second; return afterward
Block Two first; Block One second; return afterward
Give one block every session and hide the sheet
choices.hint: Both blocks are part of this agreement. Choose either two-session shared schedule.

one_first.text:
Ngozi: Block One first, Block Two second. Same sheet. Same return line.
Tunde: Our argument now has an appointment.
one_first.summary: The saved order is Block One, then Block Two, followed by return.

two_first.text:
Ngozi: Block Two first, Block One second. Everyone has a copy.
Tunde: Even the argument has stopped asking for change.
two_first.summary: The saved order is Block Two, then Block One, followed by return.

stages.title: A schedule that survives the conversation
stages.text: Keep matching copies with Iya Risi and the two blocks. The yard is now an agreed community staging location. A change requires another conversation and a revised record, not silently taking someone's session.
stages.summary: Confirm matching loan, site and shared-session records. The community staging agreement is saved.

choices.label: Confirm the matching records with the custodian and both blocks

ngozi_record.text: Ngozi: The wedding bag remains under its recorded custody. This loan has its own sheet.
ngozi_record.summary: Ngozi's recorded bag custody remains separate from the generator loan.

joint_record.text: Tunde: The jointly witnessed bag record stays as it was. The generator has earned a separate folder.
joint_record.summary: The joint bag-custody record remains separate from the generator loan.

stages.title: Power for a place to talk
stages.text:
Tunde: One generator borrowed. Two blocks still speaking.
Ngozi: Put that on the return sheet, not a campaign poster.

Generator Wars complete. Tunde and Ngozi each gain two mastery once. The agreed community location and session order remain saved; the wedding evidence and KC's phone are unchanged. Japa Interview follows.
stages.summary: The community loan, outdoor site and shared schedule are recorded. Tunde and Ngozi each gain two mastery once; no StreetCoins or new wedding clue is awarded.

choices.label: Save the community staging agreement
